data.title: Coaching Software Features for Personal Trainers
data.description: Client management, plan builders, check-ins, payments, and an AI agent that pulls plans back within guardrails when recovery signals a deload.
data.keywords: personal trainer software features, AI coach recovery signals, guardrails AI training plan, client management software, workout plan builder, meal plan software

_rationale: Previous copy mentioned only that the AI agent 'adjusts plans weekly' with no concrete trigger or safety framing. Added the recovery-signal trigger and the guardrails/bounded-change angle, which is this cycle's trust differentiator and wasn't represented in the page's keyword set at all. Feature referenced: Guardrails on AI plan changes [GAP].
